items.source: timeout - Configure the amount of time to allow the client to complete the execution of an API call. This timeout covers the entire client execution except for marshalling. This includes request handler execution, all HTTP requests including retries, unmarshalling, etc. This value should always be positive, if present.
items.translation: timeout - 配置允许客户端完成 API 调用执行的时间。 此超时时间涵盖整个客户端执行过程（除反序列化外），包括请求处理器执行、所有 HTTP 请求（含重试）、反序列化等。如果存在该值，它必须始终为正数。

items.source:
Abstract class for the Bedrock API. It provides the basic functionality to invoke the chat completion model and
receive the response for streaming and non-streaming requests.
items.translation: Bedrock API 的抽象类。它提供了调用聊天补全模型的基本功能，并支持接收流式和非流式请求的响应。
